Show the difference between a class variable and an instance variable.

Supplied answer
class Student:
    college = "KIIT" # class variable - shared
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name # instance variable - separate
s1 = Student("Surya")
s2 = Student("Amit")
print(s1.college, s2.college) # KIIT KIIT
Student.college = "Utkal" # changes it for everyone
print(s1.college, s2.college) # Utkal Utkal
Note: A class variable belongs to the class; an instance variable belongs to one object.
